pipoca.title: Slack
pipoca.description: Turns messages, mentions and reactions in Slack into routine triggers, and lets Sessions post and reply in threads as a bot. Admins add bots in Settings.

mention.title: Slack mention
mention.description: Someone mentioned the bot in a channel it is in.

bot.description: The Slack bot that heard it

user.description: Who wrote or reacted, by Slack user id

ts.description: The message's timestamp, its id in the channel

threadTs.description: The thread it is in, empty when it isn't

message.title: Slack message
message.description: A message in a channel the bot is in, or sent to the bot directly.

bot.description: The Slack bot that heard it

user.description: Who wrote or reacted, by Slack user id

ts.description: The message's timestamp, its id in the channel

reaction.title: Slack reaction
reaction.description: Someone added a reaction to a message in a channel the bot is in.
